verdict.rationale: The only built-in agentic capability in the evidence is the publish-checks 'built-in autofix flow', which fixes failed audit items. That is narrow, task-specific delegation, not a general in-product assistant. The 'Chat' mentioned in the docs appears to be for testing your own MCP server. Managing the platform from Cursor or Claude via the official MCP server relies on an external agent, so it is not a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product AI assistant that accepts delegated tasks across servers, deployments and observability; documentation of how autofix works and what it can change; independent or hands-on corroboration.
